caption: The drawing depicts a pedestal with a wide, shallow vessel on top. The pedestal features geometric patterns in red, blue, and cream tones, with circle motifs and angular sections. The base of the pedestal is hexagonal and has alternating red, blue, and cream segments. The stem of the pedestal is bulbous, decorated with red spots on a cream background. Above the stem, the bowl support section is circular and decorated with alternating blue and red teardrop-like shapes. The vessel on top is brown and oval-shaped with a lid, containing a smaller circular container and a finial-like feature. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional decorations, and the name "Marius N. Hansen" is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Baptismal Font & Stand
